courses.title: Certificate IV in Building and Construction (Building)
courses.short_description: Nationally accredited qualification (19 units) for tradies stepping up to site supervision, small-to-medium project coordination, and builder licensing pathways in Australia.
courses.email_information: CPC40120 Certificate IV in Building and Construction is tailored for tradespeople seeking career advancement into site management or builder contractor licensing. Study online with 24/7 LMS access.

courses.title: Certificate IV in Building and Construction (Building)
courses.short_description: Structured 36-week delivery format featuring scheduled online workshops and guided assessor mentoring for building practitioners.
courses.email_information: Structured blended delivery includes weekly interactive trainer-led sessions alongside comprehensive online study materials.

courses.title: Diploma of Building and Construction (Building)
courses.short_description: Advanced qualification (27 units) for experienced trades, project managers, and builders pursuing commercial/residential contractor licensing and construction leadership.
courses.email_information: CPC50220 Diploma of Building and Construction offers advanced training in building codes, project administration, and site management for building work contractor applications.

courses.title: Diploma of Building and Construction (Building)
courses.short_description: Comprehensive 62-week guided curriculum with direct trainer mentoring and industry scenario workshops.
courses.email_information: Our structured Diploma program guides you through complex construction contracts, structural principles, and estimating.
